parsed.reason: The reply does two things correctly: it states the registration window (Sep 1, 7:00 a.m., residents first) as Hale's own verified fact and confirms it is already watching — both exactly right per the rules. It then surfaces the Tiny Tumblers web find, names it clearly (name, day, age range), and flags that price isn't posted yet, which is exactly the attribution/honesty the webFind rule requires ("their site lists…", "price isn't posted yet"). The only small issue is "Their site lists" which is slightly ambiguous about whose site — the rules want something like "their program page" or "the venue's own page" — but it does gesture at a source and does not dress it up as verified. No greeting, no sign-off, no markdown, no app referral, no invented details. Very clean and actionable. Minor attribution vagueness keeps it from a 5.
